notes: Mobile Harness Code — independent fork of Mobile Harness. New: MCP (Model Context Protocol) client — the Sidekick assistant can now call external or local MCP tools (HTTP/Streamable-HTTP or stdio), with a per-server confirmation mode, fail-closed URL policy (https-only for external hosts; plain http only for local/private), input/output limits and an Eco Mode-aware budget. Manage servers in Settings → MCP Servers (add/edit/delete/toggle/Test & List Tools); tool calls are logged in Developer Tools → MCP tool log. Also keeps the local model (Ollama/llama.cpp) fallback, AI router fallback chain, Material 3 dynamic color, in-app update, Telegram bot, Sidekick assistant with background research and multimodal input, Eco Mode (Token Saver), Developer Tools, session auto-recovery, release & signing, optional server sync, reproducible build + SBOM. This APK is SIGNED (V1+V2+V3); install mobile-harness-online.apk.
